task: Make the artist page tabs (Feed/Music/Posts/Photos/Videos) URL-addressable as /artist/[slug]/[view] instead of client-only activeTab state. Navigation between views must not reload the page and must not refetch already-loaded data (no full invalidateAll). Each view's data should load lazily on first navigation to it, and stay cached once loaded (e.g. navigating away from Music and back must not refetch it).

lessons.rule: Before asserting a behavior claim (streaming semantics) or an absence claim (no test infrastructure exists), grep/read the actual source to confirm it rather than stating it as established fact.

When splitting a route's server load/actions across files, grep the original +page.server.ts for every exported action and explicitly assign each one a destination file and a decision before finalizing the plan, and hand-verify any literal string/URL snippet in a decision character-by-character before including it.

Before finalizing, re-check each spec's TDD test cases against the exact behavior the implementation decision claims to produce (e.g. an exact-string redirect path), so a mismatch is caught by the plan itself rather than by the mechanical gate.
Only converge to approved once every spec requirement maps to a decision and verifyCommands actually exercise the changed behavior — don't approve early just to shorten the round count.
